headword: {百害|ひゃくがい}あって{一利|いちり}なし
reading: ひゃくがいあっていちりなし

definitions.gloss: all harm and no good; does nothing but harm
definitions.explanation: A set phrase saying that something has a great many harmful effects and not a single benefit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{喫煙|きつえん}→喫煙：17580_kitsuen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{百害|ひゃくがい}あって{一利|いちり}なしだ。
examples.english: Smoking is all harm and no good.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜更|よふ}かし→夜更かし：07693_yofukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{百害|ひゃくがい}あって{一利|いちり}なし⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われる→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Staying up late is said to do nothing but harm.

examples.japanese: ⟦{根拠|こんきょ}→根拠：10147_konkyo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{噂|うわさ}→噂：01871_uwasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}める→広める：02405_hiromeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{百害|ひゃくがい}あって{一利|いちり}なし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧だ。
examples.english: Spreading groundless rumors is an act that does nothing but harm.

notes:
USAGE:
Literally "a hundred harms and not one benefit". Used as a predicate (〜⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{百害|ひゃくがい}あって{一利|いちり}なしだ) or before a noun with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧. By far the commonest target is smoking, and the phrase is a staple of health campaigns; it also works for any habit or practice the speaker wants to condemn outright.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {有害無益|ゆうがいむえき}: harmful and useless; a four-character compound with the same meaning, more formal
